meta.name: ab-test-analysis
meta.description: Analyze A/B test results with statistical significance, sample size validation, confidence intervals, and ship/extend/stop recommendations. Use when evaluating experiment results, checking if a test reached significance, interpreting split test data, or deciding whether to ship a variant.

copy.tagline: 分析A/B测试结果并给出决策建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常做A/B测试并需要统计依据来决策。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze A/B test results and get ship/extend/stop recommendations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run A/B tests and need statistical guidance to decide next steps.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会分析 A/B 测试数据，计算统计显著性、样本量、置信区间，并给出“发布/延长/停止/调查”的建议。
howto.when: 当你提供 A/B 测试结果数据（如 CSV、Excel 文件），或描述实验假设、指标、时长等信息时触发。

say.text: 分析这个 A/B 测试结果，判断是否显著。
say.note: Claude 会计算 p 值并给出建议。

say.text: 帮我检查这个实验的样本量是否足够。

howto.what_en: Claude analyzes A/B test results, calculates statistical significance, sample size, confidence intervals, and provides ship/extend/stop/investigate recommendations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide A/B test data (CSV, Excel) or describe experiment details like hypothesis, metrics, duration.

say_en.text: Analyze this A/B test result and tell me if it's significant.
say_en.note: Claude will compute p-value and recommend action.

say_en.text: Check if the sample size is sufficient for this test.
